## [1.1.0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0) (2026-11-17)

### ✨ New Features

* Add "Block web trackers", "Disable update prompts", "Disable rating prompts" and "Open links in browser" patches ([67e7009](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/commit/67e7009fcf560a60176092020e10aa461ba7cced))
* Add "Hide AI answers", "Hide suggested questions", "Hide Quora+ promotions", "Hide downvote button" and "Enable text selection" patches ([2d71246](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/commit/2d712464a449d1a0f0f3b1540694522615507b87))
* Add "Hide Quora+ answers", "Hide related questions", "Hide Spaces suggestions" and "Disable video autoplay" patches ([f9a3bf2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/quora-patches/commit/f9a3bf2c14476c4d5f97f856a07a07fd4e2b907d))

patches.name: Block web trackers
patches.description: Blocks requests from Quora pages to third-party analytics and tracking services.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and stops the advertising ID from being collected.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from showing the Google Play update screen.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Videos in the feed and in answers only play when you tap them.

patches.name: Enable text selection
patches.description: Lets you select and copy text on every page.

patches.name: Hide AI answers
patches.description: Hides answers written by Poe bots.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ answers
patches.description: Hides answers and posts that can only be read with a Quora+ subscription.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ promotions
patches.description: Hides buttons that ask you to try or join Quora+.

patches.name: Hide Spaces suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Spaces you might like suggestions in the feed.

patches.name: Hide downvote button
patches.description: Hides the downvote button on answers and posts.

patches.name: Hide related questions
patches.description: Hides the related questions lists on question pages.

patches.name: Hide suggested questions
patches.description: Hides the questions for you to answer in the feed.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links to other websites in your default browser instead of an in-app browser tab.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.
